name: Helio Forge
tagline: Software and hardware that keep utility-scale solar plants producing.
remote_policy: Remote-first for software roles, with plant visits a few times a year. Field and power systems roles are based in Phoenix.
content: Helio Forge builds the monitoring platform and tracker controllers behind 14 GW of solar across the US Southwest. Its software catches failing inverters before they cost a day of generation, and its controllers squeeze an extra 4% out of every array.

name: Voltcrest
tagline: Grid-scale battery storage, designed and operated in Texas.
remote_policy: Hybrid in Austin for hardware and operations. Data and software roles can be fully remote within the US.
content: Voltcrest designs, installs and runs lithium iron phosphate battery sites for ERCOT. Its own battery management system and dispatch models decide, every five minutes, when to charge and when to sell.

name: Gridwise
tagline: The operating system for distributed energy on the grid.
remote_policy: Remote-first since day one. Hire anywhere in Canada and the US, meet in person twice a year.
content: Gridwise helps utilities coordinate millions of rooftop panels, home batteries and EV chargers as one flexible resource. Twelve utilities across North America run their demand response programs on it.

name: Deepwell Carbon
tagline: Direct air capture with permanent geological storage.
remote_policy: Plant and lab roles are on-site near Denver. Commercial and MRV roles are remote within the US.
content: Deepwell Carbon pulls CO2 out of the air and stores it a mile underground in basalt. Its first commercial plant comes online in 2027, and its removal credits are already contracted through 2030.

name: Tidal Loop
tagline: Fast charging for fleets and the drivers who run them.
remote_policy: Remote within the EU for most roles, with an office in Amsterdam for anyone who wants one.
content: Tidal Loop operates 3,800 fast chargers across nine countries and the software that books, prices and balances them. Delivery fleets, taxis and buses are its biggest customers.

name: Furrow
remote_policy: Fully remote within the US, with a summer field week in Iowa.
content: Furrow measures soil carbon, cover crops and tillage from satellite and field data, so farmers can get paid for regenerative practices without a pile of paperwork.

name: Thermal Union
tagline: Heat pumps for every building in the Northeast.
remote_policy: Hybrid in Boston, three days in the office. Some engineering roles are remote within US Eastern time.
content: Thermal Union designs, sells and installs heat pumps for homes and commercial buildings across New England, and runs the installer platform that schedules 600 jobs a week.

name: Canopy Analytics
tagline: Emissions and land-use data from space.
remote_policy: Remote within the EU and UK. Berlin office for those nearby.
content: Canopy Analytics turns satellite imagery into emissions, deforestation and land-use data that banks, insurers and governments use to track climate risk and commitments.

name: Saltmarsh Labs
tagline: Measuring how much carbon the ocean can safely store.
remote_policy: Field science roles are in Seattle. Software roles are remote within the US.
content: Saltmarsh Labs builds ocean sensors and models to measure carbon removal from kelp and ocean alkalinity projects, so the credits behind them can be trusted.

name: Ampere Commons
tagline: Community solar that anyone can subscribe to.
remote_policy: Hybrid in Brooklyn, with remote options for product and engineering within the US.
content: Ampere Commons connects renters and homeowners to local community solar farms. Subscribers save on their bills, and 40,000 households in New York and New Jersey already do.
